heroBody: We've embarked on the journey to democratize technology and ensure prosperity for all humanity. We are committed to free, humane AI aligned with the values of humanity, not any single special interest group. Heraldic is a pioneer company in AI governance solutions, with a commitment to open-source software, Web3.0, blockchain, privacy-respecting anti-tracking apps, and distributed applications. Everything we build, we build in service of humanity.

ctaLabel: Take back control of your AI, Cloud and business.
visionTitle: A personal desktop, without a physical box.
visionBody: Our cloud computing services pair virtualized resources with the devices people already use.
capabilityBody: Heraldic’s cloud computing services use virtual hardware to extend what a device can do.
capabilityOneBody: Create additional capacity without installing physical components.
capabilityTwoBody: Support work on an older PC or lightweight device through a hosted desktop.
capabilityThreeBody: Use an operating environment and applications from wherever an internet connection is available.
systemsBody: Our cloud desktops use GPUs, everyday work, gaming and entertainment
eleetBody: A powerful personal cloud desktop for graphics-intensive work, helping a local device stay cool and light.
powerBody: A flexible cloud PC concept for office work and entertainment, intended to be reachable across desktop and mobile devices.
newbieBody: A free, lightweight Linux environment centered on web use, creativity, study, and broader access to computing.
privacyTitle: Your data is not a commodity.
privacyBodyOne: We believe humane technology should respect the people it serves. We will never collect or sell your data. Transparency is key to trust. Heraldic has helped businesses and individuals avoid vendor lock-in, save on cloud solutions, and regain control of their data. We offer open-source, privacy-respecting alternatives.
privacyBodyTwo: Our apps are privacy-respecting and anti-tracking by design, with no trackers, ads, affiliate storefronts, or automatically loaded third-party embeds. The Kickstarter video player loads only when you request it. Messages you submit to Artem AI are sent to OpenAI to generate a reply.
missionBody: We can help you build advanced AI agents that can automate your business at any scale—even your whole business. Imagine enjoying a piña colada on the beach while your AI agent is working your customer service, email reply, sales, and more!
heraldicPageIntro: Heraldic builds technology that expands access to powerful computing, AI, and digital tools. Our services include cloud computing, business automation, gaming cloud desktops, AI social media, and work toward AGI.
leadershipBio: Artem D. graduated from Bellevue College with a degree in Computer Science. He has founded several startups, presented research posters at NVIDIA GTC two years in a row, and was recognized by CompTIA as a Subject Matter Expert in cloud technologies.
missionQuote: “We do not believe your data is gold. Transparency is key to trust.”
meaIntro: Mise En Abyme is a desktop experience shaped by software, hardware, and the web—available from the devices people already use.

meaFeatureTwo: Streams YOUR games from the cloud
